::: {#exr-why-shrink}

#### Why the gradient shrinks

In a deep [MLP](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-feedforward-network), [hidden layer](feedforward-networks.qmd#def-hidden-layer) $\layeridx$ is $\vhidval_{\layeridx} = g\paren{\vz_{\layeridx}}$ with $\vz_{\layeridx} = \matr{W}_{\layeridx} \vhidval_{\layeridx - 1} + \vecf{b}_{\layeridx}$.
Why does the [gradient](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/linear-regression.html#def-gradient) shrink from layer to layer, going back, when $g$ is the [logistic function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/functions.html#def-logistic-function)?

:::
